name: model-balance
description: Spends fewer tokens on the same work: a router picks each prompt's model and effort, and the main conversation answers it or hands it to a Haiku, Sonnet or Opus worker subagent pinned to both, never at max. Main briefs each worker and relays its report, follow-ups continue the last worker, /subtask and forks get a pinned effort, and a board shows the running subagents with the finished ones behind a button. Off at the start of every session, switched on per session.

router_model.title: Router model
router_model.description: Model that rates each prompt before routing it. Sonnet judges follow-ups and questions the main conversation can answer more reliably; Haiku answers faster. The other one stands in when it fails.

router_effort.title: Router effort
router_effort.description: Effort the router rates each prompt at, choosing both the worker's model and its effort. A rating is one short request, so it never needs more than high.

haiku_effort.title: Haiku worker effort
haiku_effort.description: Effort the Haiku worker runs at when the router names none (a #haiku prefix, the heuristic), set as its agent definition's effort. 'session' sets none and leaves it to Claude Code's own resolution. Subagents never run at max.
